subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: The system shall bind a lock approval to the exact draft version presented and void it when the draft changes before lock. In local-git mode it shall also bind approval to the current proposal generation, workflow-derived target ref and existing target SHA, readiness digest, and request nonce, and refuse any mismatch at landing.
rationale: Certifies the content and landing context that were actually presented, including a revision that restores an old head
fit_criterion: Hosted change-after-request fixtures retain their verdicts. Local changed-head, changed-target-ref, moved-target, changed-digest, changed-proposal-generation, and H1→H2→H1 fixtures refuse the old receipt before any landing write and require fresh preparation and review.
